checkpoint_rule: Lead ruling: no close at the ceiling. At each ceiling, if the last three productive iterations hold a new P0 or P1 that survived orchestrator verification, extend by five and score again; close only when three in a row are clean. A P1 lowered on evidence does not count. Lead confirmation: close as soon as three consecutive productive iterations hold no new verified P0 or P1 and the coverage items of the bar hold (every release read, all seven types probed, strongest claims verified); an extension need not run to its ceiling. The score is recorded at close.
summary: The doctor, git, CI and runtime-mirror surfaces report healthier than they are. Several checkers cannot fail: symlink-engine check exits 0 on any drift, the orphan-process check exits 0 when it cannot scan, and two doctor checkers reject the --check flag their own route passes. Coverage gates are narrower than their names: the sk-git CI job runs one suite of five, agents-md-manifest --check fails today and no workflow runs it, and the agent parity gate checks three of seven runtime trees with its opencode arm comparing a file with itself. The .opencode to .skilled symlink aliases are the most common source of both real defects (hook status SHADOWED) and false findings: three iteration claims of duplicate files were refuted because the parent directory is a symlink.
recommendations:
1. Give symlink-engine check a non-zero exit on any drift status (symlink-engine.cjs:1801) and make orphan-process-check return 1 on scan failure (:560, :568).
2. Add the four missing sk-git suites and node .skilled/commands/doctor/scripts/agents-md-manifest.cjs --check as steps in sk-git-script-tests.yml, and rename the job to what it runs.
3. Extend RUNTIME_MIRRORS to every runtime tree that ships agents and drop or repoint the opencode arm, which reads the canonical file through a symlink.
4. Compare hook paths by realpath in install-git-hooks.sh resolve_target and in git-setup-check checkHooks, and make checkHooks ignore a global core.hooksPath unless the repo opted into it.
5. Accept --check in agent-roster-mirror-check.cjs and command-catalog-mirror-check.cjs, or drop it from doctor-runtime-mirrors.yaml.
6. Before filing any duplicate-file finding, test inode identity (stat dev and ino) rather than readlink on the file.
